summary.text: Cheryl Youakim is a Democratic member of the Minnesota House of Representatives for District 46B, in office since January 2015, and is running for re-election on November 3, 2026, against Republican Kim Rich. She is co-chair of the Education Finance Committee and a former Hopkins City Council member.

paragraphs.text: Cheryl Youakim earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Minnesota and previously served on the Hopkins City Council.
She assumed office in the Minnesota House on January 6, 2015.
Youakim defeated Kim Rich in the November 5, 2024, general election for District 46B.
For 2025-2026 Ballotpedia lists her as co-chair of the Education Finance Committee and a member of the House Taxes and Ways and Means committees.
